services.name: Gay Sailing
services.desc: A guest inquiry this week reminded me that sometimes you really do have to toot your own horn. It’s not my natural move, but I’m proud of what I’ve built and how different it is in the gay sailing world. And just to be clear, this isn’t shade. We’re all out here creating community and queer adventure together. It’s a small gay world, but there’s plenty of ocean for all of us! I offer a relaxing, connecting, welcoming gay sailing experience. One that is drama free, and where you are free to be your authentic self. Guests enjoy days in turquoise bays with swimming, shared meals, and a welcoming environment. Clothing is optional, embracing comfort and connection among guests.
